scale_statistic: Configs that read the width histogram of Scale-Balanced-Grasp were probed with the reference's own file (`scale_statistic.source: legacy_import`, the SHA-256 in the probe command): the native histogram is a statistic of a whole training split, and a probe reads eight frames.

undecided.needs consent: refused by a policy that waits for the user's consent (`trust_remote_code` needs `accept_remote_code: true`): a rule about this machine, not about the combination
undecided.not a combination: the request names a component that lacks an option only a preset supplies: it is refused before any contract is compared, and is no combination
undecided.not checked: the record was judged by the first judge, which recorded neither the trend of the loss terms nor the scores of the predicted grasps
undecided.not probed: the grid has the cell, but no record yet
undecided.not reached by the method as shipped: the method as shipped, probed the same way, does not reach this level either (for example FineGrasp at the constant rate, whose fusion of crop scales gives every seed one feature in a short run, so every grasp gets one score): under that method the level says nothing about the option at this budget
undecided.unstable, not repeated: the probe was `runs-unstable` and has not been repeated: an unstable run counts as not running only when a second probe of the same config is unstable too

verdicts.fails: An exception was raised after the config check had passed. The report names the phase (build, data, optimizer, loss, backward, step, hook, predict), the component it came from and the message.
verdicts.refused: The config check refused the config (the same check as `grasppanda print-config --check --for train`). Nothing was built; the report carries the messages.
verdicts.runs: On real frames: the detector was built, every requested training iteration ran with finite losses and at least one real seed, every top-level part of the model that holds trainable parameters received a gradient in at least one iteration, the weights stayed finite, and prediction returned one valid grasp group for every probed frame, at least one of them with a grasp.
verdicts.runs-empty: As `runs`, except that no probed frame has a grasp: prediction returned one valid grasp group for every probed frame and every group is empty. Every stage ran; a model trained for a few iterations often keeps no seed. A run that is also unstable is `runs-unstable`.
verdicts.runs-unstable: On real frames: the detector was built, trained and predicted, but a loss or a weight became non-finite (a non-finite loss ends the training there), or an iteration had no real seed (no scene point passed the proposal, so only the proposal was trained), or no iteration supervised a seed, or a top-level part with trainable parameters received no gradient in any iteration, or fewer iterations ran or fewer frames were predicted than were asked for.
